```{r setup, include=FALSE}
OUT <- file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "outputs")   # exp1/outputs
FIG <- file.path(OUT, "figures")
dir.create(FIG, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
set.seed(1)  # the bootstraps, the normal approximation and Stan were unseeded in the original
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidybayes)
library(rstan)
library(ggpattern)
library(boot)

mytheme <-
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = (25), colour = "steelblue4"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = (25), colour = "steelblue4", face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "cornflowerblue", size = (25)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(vjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 25),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 25),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 25),
    legend.key.size = unit(2, 'cm')
  )

cb1 <- c("#999999", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7")

save_figure <- function(name, width, height, plot = last_plot()) {
  ggsave(file.path(FIG, name), plot = plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
}
```

## Load in the datasets

```{r}
INFO_TYPES <- c("Advice", "Spied")
HUMANS <- "Humans (p < .05)"
LLMS <- c("GPT-4o (Direct)", "GPT-4o (CoT)", "Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Direct)", "Claude 3.5 Sonnet (CoT)")
LEGEND_ORDER <- c("Claude 3.5 Sonnet (CoT)", "Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Direct)", "GPT-4o (CoT)", "GPT-4o (Direct)", HUMANS)

shifts <- read_csv(file.path(OUT, "shifts.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Model = if_else(model == "human", HUMANS,
                         paste0(label, if_else(instructions == "cot", " (CoT)", " (Direct)"))),
         Shift = shift)
llm_shifts <- filter(shifts, Model != HUMANS)
gpt_cot <- filter(shifts, Model == "GPT-4o (CoT)")

pull_shifts <- function(data, who, type) filter(data, Model == .env$who, Type == .env$type)$Shift
```

## Player two descriptives (GPT-4o, CoT)

Participant's use of social information - their "shift" strategy

```{r}
shift_histogram <- function(data, facets) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Shift)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 25, fill = "#999999", col = "black") +
    labs(x = "Proportion shift") +
    mytheme +
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
    facet_grid(facets)
}

gpt_cot %>%
  mutate(Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("Cooperative", "Competitive"))) %>%
  shift_histogram(~Condition)
save_figure("Information_shift.png", 12, 6)

gpt_cot %>%
  mutate(`Information type` = factor(Type, levels = INFO_TYPES)) %>%
  shift_histogram(~`Information type`)
save_figure("Information_shift_by_type.png", 12, 6)
```

Normal approximation to the difference in mean shift (spied minus advice):

```{r}
advice_shifts <- pull_shifts(gpt_cot, "GPT-4o (CoT)", "Advice")
spied_shifts <- pull_shifts(gpt_cot, "GPT-4o (CoT)", "Spied")
n_draws <- 10000
samples_advice <- rnorm(n_draws, mean(advice_shifts), sd(advice_shifts) / sqrt(length(advice_shifts)))
samples_spied <- rnorm(n_draws, mean(spied_shifts), sd(spied_shifts) / sqrt(length(spied_shifts)))
diff_samples <- samples_spied - samples_advice

tibble(Diff = diff_samples) %>%
  summarise(
    `Mean Diff` = mean(Diff),
    `95% CI Lower` = quantile(Diff, 0.025),
    `95% CI Upper` = quantile(Diff, 0.975),
    `P(Spied > Advice)` = mean(Diff > 0)
  )
```

## Model two

```{r}
Player_two <- read.csv(file.path(OUT, "Player_two_gpt-4o_cot.csv")) %>%
  mutate(Answer_difference = (Second_answer - First_answer),
         Information_difference = Social_info - First_answer) %>%
  filter(Information_difference != 0) %>%
  mutate(Condition_recoded = case_when(
           Condition == "Cooperative" ~ 1,
           Condition == "Competitive" ~ 2
         ),
         Condition_recoded = factor(Condition_recoded),
         Spied = ifelse(Type == "Spied", 1, 0),
         Advice = ifelse(Type == "Advice", 1, 0),
         participant_id = match(participant_id, unique(participant_id)),
         participant_id = factor(participant_id))

table(Player_two$Spied, Player_two$Type)
table(Player_two$Advice, Player_two$Type)
table(Player_two$Condition) / 20   # 20 rows of data per participant
```

Reminder of the conditions: 1 = Cooperative, 2 = Competitive.

```{r}
B_stan <- Player_two %>%
  compose_data(y = Answer_difference,
               Info_type = Type,
               Condition = Condition_recoded,
               ppt = participant_id,
               Advice = Advice,
               Spied = Spied)

table("Type" = B_stan$Type, "Advice" = B_stan$Advice)
```

Non centered parameterisation was necessary for this model to run.

```{stan output.var="B_Model_1"}
data {
  int<lower=1> n;
  vector[n] Answer_difference;
  vector[n] Information_difference;
  int n_participant_id;
  int Advice[n];
  int Condition[n];
  int ppt[n];
}
parameters {
  real<lower=0,upper=5> sigma;
  real<lower=0,upper=5> sigma_participant;
  vector[2] b_condition;
  real b_advice;
  vector[n_participant_id] participant_effect;
}
transformed parameters {
  vector[n] influence;
  vector[n] mu;
  for(i in 1:n){
   influence[i] = b_condition[Condition[i]] * (1 + b_advice * Advice[i]) + participant_effect[ppt[i]];
   mu[i] =  influence[i] * Information_difference[i];
  }
}
model {
  Answer_difference ~ normal(mu, sigma);
  sigma ~ exponential(1);
  b_advice ~ normal(0,0.5);
  b_condition ~ normal(0,0.5);
  participant_effect ~ normal(0, sigma_participant);
  sigma_participant ~ exponential(1);
}
```

```{r}
ModelB_1 <- sampling(B_Model_1, iter = 5000, warmup = 1500, chains = 4, cores = 4, data = B_stan)
ModelB_1
```

### Generating predictions

```{r}
Model_1B <- extract(ModelB_1)
Cooperative_condition <- Model_1B$b_condition[,1]
Competitive_condition <- Model_1B$b_condition[,2]
Advice <- Model_1B$b_advice
```

Parameter intervals, and the contrast between the conditions

```{r}
mean_qi(Cooperative_condition)
mean_qi(Competitive_condition)
mean_qi(Advice)
mean_qi(Competitive_condition - Cooperative_condition)
```

```{r}
Influence_Predictions <- tibble(
  Cooperative_Spied = Cooperative_condition,
  Cooperative_Advice = Cooperative_condition * (1 + Advice),
  Competitive_Spied = Competitive_condition,
  Competitive_Advice = Competitive_condition * (1 + Advice)
)

Plotting_influence_predictions <- Influence_Predictions %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Combination", values_to = "Estimate") %>%
  separate(Combination, into = c("Condition", "Information type"))

Plotting_influence_predictions %>%
  mutate(Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("Cooperative", "Competitive"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Condition, y = Estimate, fill = `Information type`)) +
  stat_eye(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cb1) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.05, 1)) +
  mytheme +
  labs(y = "Social influence") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 22, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 22, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, color = "black")
  )
save_figure("Influence_plot.png", 12, 8)
```

Predicted influence values

```{r}
Plotting_influence_predictions %>%
  group_by(Condition, `Information type`) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Estimate),
    `Upper 95%` = HDInterval::hdi(Estimate, credMass = 0.95)[2],
    `Lower 95%` = HDInterval::hdi(Estimate, credMass = 0.95)[1],
    `P(Estimate > 0)` = mean(Estimate > 0),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# P(Cooperative > Competitive), for advice and for spied information
mean(Influence_Predictions$Cooperative_Advice > Influence_Predictions$Competitive_Advice)
mean(Influence_Predictions$Cooperative_Spied > Influence_Predictions$Competitive_Spied)
```

## LLMs vs. humans: average shift by information type

```{r}
basic_ci <- function(x) {  # basic bootstrap interval for the mean, 1000 resamples
  b <- boot(x, function(d, i) mean(d[i]), R = 1000)
  2 * mean(x) - quantile(b$t, c(0.975, 0.025), names = FALSE)
}

summarise_shifts <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    group_by(Model = factor(Model, levels = LEGEND_ORDER), Type) %>%
    summarise(Average_Shift = mean(Shift), CI = list(basic_ci(Shift)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(CI_Low = map_dbl(CI, 1), CI_High = map_dbl(CI, 2)) %>%
    select(-CI)
}

type_means <- function(data) data %>% group_by(Type) %>% summarise(Shift = mean(Shift)) %>% deframe()

shift_summary <- summarise_shifts(shifts)
llm_summary <- filter(shift_summary, Model != HUMANS)
print(shift_summary, n = Inf)

llm_means <- type_means(llm_shifts)
all_means <- type_means(shifts)
human_means <- type_means(filter(shifts, Model == HUMANS))
cat(sprintf("Average proportion shift, %-26s Advice %.4f, Spied %.4f\n",
            c("all four LLM conditions:", "LLMs and humans together:"),
            c(llm_means["Advice"], all_means["Advice"]), c(llm_means["Spied"], all_means["Spied"])), sep = "")
```

Three versions of the bar chart. The last one is `average_info_shift_graph.png`; in the original notebook
all three were saved under that name, so only the last survived.

```{r}
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.9)
bar_style <- list(
  labs(x = "Information Type", y = "Average Proportion Shift",
       title = "Average Proportion Shift by Information Type and Model", fill = "Player 2 Entity"),
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16),
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18), plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 50, b = 10, l = 10))
)
ci_bars <- geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_Low, ymax = CI_High), position = dodge, width = 0.2, color = "black")
baselines <- function(y, labels) list(
  geom_segment(data = tibble(Type = INFO_TYPES, y = y, Label = labels),
               aes(x = as.numeric(factor(Type)) - 0.45, xend = as.numeric(factor(Type)) + 0.45,
                   y = y, yend = y, linetype = Label),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "", values = setNames(c("dashed", "dotdash"), labels))
)
patterned_bars <- function(data) {  # colour = model family, stripes = CoT
  stripes <- if_else(str_detect(levels(droplevels(data$Model)), "CoT"), "stripe", "none")
  list(
    geom_bar_pattern(aes(pattern = if_else(str_detect(Model, "CoT"), "stripe", "none")),
                     stat = "identity", position = dodge, width = 0.9, color = "black", pattern_fill = "black",
                     pattern_angle = 45, pattern_density = 0.1, pattern_spacing = 0.02, pattern_key_scale_factor = 0.6),
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("GPT-4o (Direct)" = "forestgreen", "GPT-4o (CoT)" = "forestgreen",
                                 "Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Direct)" = "firebrick", "Claude 3.5 Sonnet (CoT)" = "firebrick",
                                 "Humans (p < .05)" = "steelblue")),
    scale_pattern_manual(values = c("none" = "none", "stripe" = "stripe")),
    guides(pattern = "none", fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(pattern = stripes)))
  )
}

ggplot(shift_summary, aes(x = Type, y = Average_Shift, fill = Model)) + patterned_bars(shift_summary) + bar_style
save_figure("average_info_shift_graph_patterned.png", 10, 6)

ggplot(llm_summary, aes(x = Type, y = Average_Shift, fill = Model)) + patterned_bars(llm_summary) + ci_bars +
  baselines(llm_means, c("Advice Baseline", "Spied Baseline")) + bar_style
save_figure("average_info_shift_graph_patterned_ci.png", 10, 6)

ggplot(llm_summary, aes(x = Type, y = Average_Shift, fill = Model)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = dodge, width = 0.9, color = "black") +
  ci_bars +
  baselines(round(human_means, 2), c("Human Baseline (Advice)", "Human Baseline (Spied)")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("GPT-4o (Direct)" = "#A6CEE3", "GPT-4o (CoT)" = "#1F78B4",
                               "Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Direct)" = "#FDD86E", "Claude 3.5 Sonnet (CoT)" = "#FDBF11")) +
  bar_style +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(shift_summary$CI_High) + 0.1))
save_figure("average_info_shift_graph.png", 10, 4)
```

## t-tests

```{r}
for (m in LLMS) {   # spied > advice, within each model
  t_result <- t.test(pull_shifts(shifts, m, "Spied"), pull_shifts(shifts, m, "Advice"), alternative = "greater")
  cat(sprintf("\nModel: %s\n  t = %.3f, df = %.1f, p-value = %.4g\n",
              m, t_result$statistic, t_result$parameter, t_result$p.value))
}

for (m in LLMS) {   # each model vs. the human participants
  for (type in INFO_TYPES) {
    t_result <- t.test(pull_shifts(shifts, m, type), pull_shifts(shifts, HUMANS, type))
    cat(sprintf("\n%s vs. Humans — %s:\n  t = %.3f, df = %.1f, p = %.4g\n",
                m, type, t_result$statistic, t_result$parameter, t_result$p.value))
  }
}
```

## Correct vs. incorrect first guesses (LLMs)

```{r}
for (result in c("Correct", "Incorrect")) {
  p <- ggplot(summarise_shifts(filter(llm_shifts, Result == result)),
              aes(x = Type, y = Average_Shift, fill = Model)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = dodge, color = "black") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_Low, ymax = CI_High), position = dodge, width = 0.2) +
    labs(title = sprintf("Average Proportion Shift (%s Only)", result),
         x = "Information Type", y = "Proportion Shift", fill = "Model") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16)
  print(p)
  save_figure(sprintf("average_shift_%s_only.png", tolower(result)), 10, 6, plot = p)
}

cat("\nP-values for Correct vs Incorrect Shift (within each Model × Type)\n")
cat("-------------------------------------------------------------------\n")
for (m in c(LLMS, HUMANS)) {
  for (type in INFO_TYPES) {
    correct <- pull_shifts(filter(llm_shifts, Result == "Correct"), m, type)
    incorrect <- pull_shifts(filter(llm_shifts, Result == "Incorrect"), m, type)
    p <- if (length(correct) > 2 && length(incorrect) > 2) t.test(correct, incorrect)$p.value else NA
    cat(sprintf("%-30s | %-7s  →  p = %.4g\n", m, type, p))
  }
}
```
